name: Paradip
notes: Major deep-water bulk terminal on Odisha coast; capesize-capable outer channel.

name: Visakhapatnam
notes: Natural harbour; inner-harbour draft materially shallower than outer anchorage.

name: Gangavaram
notes: Private deep-water port purpose-built for capesize dry-bulk.

name: Gopalpur
notes: Shallow-draft merchant port; capesize/panamax not compatible.

name: Dhamra
notes: Deep-water private port; among the few Indian east-coast berths taking capesize.

name: Sagar-Sandheads
notes: Outer anchorage serving Kolkata dock system; larger parcels lightered here, drives congestion.

name: Haldia
notes: Tidal river port on the Hooghly; hard draft ceiling, handysize only.
